Class Constraints

java.lang.Object
org.clafer.alloy.solve.Constraints
public final class Constraints extends Object
The constraints of the Alloy code that an unsat core can name, as claferIG's Constraints.hs has them: the cardinalities of the clafers and the constraints of the model, each at its span in the Alloy code.
